title: Replay the sortie's events in the flow with a minimum visible time per step
goal: The flow animates from the sortie's ordered event sequence, each step shown for a minimum visible time and replayed in order, instead of from state sampled at each poll
acceptance: The flow keeps a queue of the sortie's events since the last one shown and plays them in order; each step and arrow stays lit for at least a minimum visible time (a named constant, about 1 s), long steps for their real duration while live
B-147-T01 passes unchanged; a sortie that ended between polls still plays its missed steps once, then rests on its final state
A finished sortie opened later shows its final state without replaying, unless asked to; no simulated steps (area notes, Frontend)
Uses the per-round order and durations of F-129-T01 when they exist, the ledger events otherwise; an unchanged poll leaves the DOM in place
privacy: Neutral invented sorties, devices and names only; tokens and pairing codes never in tests or logs.
escalation: A visible change in how the flow looks or behaves goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: an event queue with a minimum display time in the flow component, plus catch-up and finished-sortie cases. Not a measurement.
